note: Layered hero colours (docs/character-appearance-layered-spec.md). Index = CharacterAppearanceData.hairColorIndex / outfitColorIndex: never reorder, only append (saved characters keep their index; CharacterAppearanceData.HairColorCount / OutfitColorCount must match). Each colour is the BASE tone (#999999 grey of the art); HeroRecolor.shader and Tools/hero_recolor_core.py build the dark and light tones from it. RO Soft Fantasy tones (user 19/11): warm, light, softly saturated, from the style board (mint #48B6A5, sky #78B7F0, coral #E46C77, gold #F4C66A); no pure black, no neon. Hair Color Palette V3.0 (ChatGPT 24/11, docs/reference/character-v3/hair-ingame/hair-palette-v2-chatgpt.txt): each hair colour also has hairRamps[i] = deep, shadow, base, light, outline; HeroRecolor.shader maps the hair greys onto those five tones instead of deriving them from the base. Index 8 starlight blonde (ChatGPT 24/11, Starward Knight V3; light #FFF0B7 -> #F5DEAB after the in-game review, starward-knight-v3-ingame-verdict-chatgpt.txt; docs/reference/character-v3/starward-knight-v3/starward-knight-v3-design-answers-chatgpt.txt).
